prompt: A cozy, dimly lit living room decorated for a purple-themed Halloween party. The scene features deep plum-colored walls and dark wooden ceiling beams. In the center, a stone fireplace glows with a warm fire, topped by a garland of red berries, candles, and a jack-o'-lantern. A framed painting of a spooky castle under a full moon hangs above the mantel. To the left, a plush burgundy sofa is adorned with a white crocheted blanket and pillows featuring ghost and skull patterns. A large orange pumpkin sits on the floor near a round rug with a star pattern. On the right, a large projection screen displays a skeleton dancing alongside a numbered list of songs or items in yellow text. Small pumpkins and glowing lights are scattered across the floor and shelves, creating an inviting, festive atmosphere.

promptZh: 一间温馨且灯光昏暗的客厅，专为紫色主题的万圣节派对而装饰。场景以深梅子色的墙壁和深色木质天花板横梁为特色。中央是一座石砌壁炉，温暖的火焰在其中跳跃，壁炉架上摆放着由红浆果、蜡烛和南瓜灯组成的花环。壁炉上方悬挂着一幅描绘满月下阴森城堡的镶框画作。左侧是一张舒适的酒红色沙发，上面铺着白色钩针编织毯，并点缀着印有幽灵和骷髅图案的抱枕。地板上靠近带有星星图案的圆形地毯处，放置着一个大橙色南瓜。右侧的大投影屏幕上显示着一个跳舞的骷髅，旁边是黄色文字列出的歌曲或物品编号列表。小南瓜和发光灯饰散落在地板和架子上，营造出一种诱人且喜庆的氛围。
